sloka: मन्ये तु हृदयं तस्याः कौसल्यायाः फलिष्यति।एकपुत्रा यदा पुत्रं विनष्टं श्रोष्यते युधि ।। ६.९३.५६ ।।
transliteration: manye tu hṛdayaṁ tasyāḥ kausalyāyāḥ phaliṣyati।ekaputrā yadā putraṁ vinaṣṭaṁ śroṣyate yudhi ।। 6.93.56 ।।

translations.english: 'I am a foolish woman. I did not follow Hanuman's advice and had I left mounted on his back, no doubt I would be on my husband 's lap. I did not think in this way'.
